utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone in the courtroom. The witness should be brought in, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. Blaszczyk. Please sit down. I would like to remind you that the affirmation to tell the truth you made at the beginning of your testimony on the 26th of April still applies.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I understand, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: And now we have a new part of your examination-in-chief, and Mr. Thayer has some questions for you, I suppose. Mr. Thayer, good morning.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Good morning to you and to Your Honours. Good morning to the Defence, good morning everyone in the courtroom. Before we get started with the examination-in-chief, Mr. President, I just wanted to give Your Honours a brief overview of the multimedia extravaganza we have in store for you over the - I think what's going to be the next two days probably, when all is said and done with cross-examination. I think we estimated three hours for examination-in-chief for the witness. I think that's off, frankly. In the last trial, and as I was getting ready, I noticed that the examination-in-chief in the last trial took a full day plus part of a session. I think we're actually going to be moving a little bit more slowly this time around than last time around. There are a couple new exhibits and a couple additional questions I think that are worth going into. So I wanted to give the Court the heads up that we will probably not finish with the examination in chief today, so we can look forward to Mr. Blaszczyk returning tomorrow and probably taking most of the day with cross-examination as well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Thayer. The Chamber appreciates this update before the commencement of the examination-in-chief.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: The presentation of the testimony will comprise essentially two components. The first is, and I don't know if Your Honours have in hand yet the actual hard copy road books, but what we will be doing is reviewing page by page this colour hard copy road book in conjunction with viewing the Petrovic video. We'll be watching that, what we refer to sometimes as raw footage of the Petrovic video, which is the basis for the road book simultaneously with going through the road book and discussing what Mr. Blaszczyk has done. The second component --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Before you -- before you move to the second component, are you mentioning this piece of paper we received.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Yes, I am, Mr. President --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Petrovic video?

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: -- yes. And that is, for the record, P1251, which has been MFI'd in connection with, I think, 92 bis with cross testimony of Mr. Petrovic. So it's been pre-marked in connection with that witness, but I think that we'll be obviously using it much more in the next day or so. So we'll be going through that, and there will be two occasions when Mr. Blaszczyk will pilot, basically, an interactive CD which will allow the user and ultimately Your Honours back in Chambers to view many of the same images but from multiple perspectives with 360 degree fish-eye rotational abilities, hyperlinks at various points in the photographs, and you'll see how all this works, but that will be another component with respect to the footage from Potocari and then footage on the road, as we call that. So that's what we have in store for you, and unless there are any further inquiries, I'll --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Once again, Mr. Thayer, we found on our desk here in the courtroom in book called "Popovic et al., Petrovic Video," with an ERN number, and then CD with presentation included inside the back cover.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Yes. The --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Is that the P1251 exhibit marked for identification?

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: That is -- that is the road book that you have in your hands, Mr. President. The CD itself will be furnished to the Trial Chamber separately, and that is 65 ter 2178, but indeed we are talking about this colour binder that you have before you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Good morning, sir.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Good morning, sir.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: I know you've been here not too long ago, but you probably need to spell your -- state and spell your name for the record.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: My name is Tomasz Blaszczyk, B-l-a-s-z-c-z-y-k.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, before we begin working with the book, Your Honours have obviously seen large portions of the Petrovic video recently and heard Ms. Gallagher's testimony about portions of that; for example, how Mr. Petrovic recorded over two key portions of the original footage that he shot during those days in Srebrenica, how he turned over that altered version to the OTP, but at the same time you also heard how the OTP is in possession of a version of that original footage that includes the portions which Mr. Petrovic recorded over. So we won't go into too much detail about -- about those matters, but we will get to some of that.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: So perhaps, Mr. Blaszczyk, could we start off talking a little bit about Mr. Petrovic. Could you tell the Trial Chamber a little bit about who is he, what was he doing in the Srebrenica area in July of 1995?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Zoran Petrovic, using the name also Pirocanac, he was a Serbian journalist. He was in the Srebrenica area on the 13th and 14th of July, 1995. During his presence in Srebrenica AOR, he recorded some events which had happened at that time in Srebrenica area, mostly in Potocari and on the road from Bratunac towards Konjevic Polje, mostly on the part of this road Kravica, Pervani, Sandici meadow, and Lolici, and he spent only these two days in -- in Srebrenica area in fact in this -- this -- this area. The first day in Potocari he recorded events in Potocari. He recorded group of the people who were in Potocari on the 13 of July, 1995, and he moved to the part of the road between Bratunac and Konjevic Polje, mostly, as I said, Kravica, Sandici, Lolici, Pervani, this road. And on the following day, on the 14 of July, he returned to Srebrenica. He recorded some footages in Srebrenica and also in Zeleni Jadar. According to his statement and his testimony, he arrived to Srebrenica with the help of Mr. Ljubisa Borovcanin who facilitated him to pass the border between Serbia and Bosnia-Herzegovina in the place called Ljubovija, this is near Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And just remind us again who is Mr. Ljubisa Borovcanin.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Ljubisa Borovcanin is the deputy head of the Special Police Brigade of Bosnia-Herzegovina and he serves in Republika Srpska at that time, and he was commanding officer of the police forces in this area.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And during this period of time, was Mr. Petrovic travelling alone with Mr. Borovcanin or did Petrovic bring anybody with him from Serbia.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Petrovic, Pirocanac, was alone in Bosnia-Herzegovina but he was always -- most of the time he was together with Mr. Borovcanin and was travelling with his car and with his driver.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And when you say his car and his driver, just to be precise, whose car and whose driver?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I mean the car of Mr. Borovcanin used by Mr. Borovcanin, and driver of Mr. Borovcanin was the police officer called Nedjo Jovicic.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And have you met Mr. Petrovic?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I met Mr. Petrovic. The first time I met him in this is February 2006. I met him in Belgrade. We interview him in Belgrade field office. And later on in later stage I met him here in The Hague also.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And again, Your Honours, Mr. Petrovic, who is Witness number 183, was a proposed 92 bis witness. Pursuant to Your Honours' order, he will be appearing for cross-examination probably sooner than later given Mr. Blaszczyk's accelerated testimony. We'll try to bring him in before too long. Now, sir, when you interviewed Mr. Petrovic in February of 2006, did he physically hand anything over to you at that time?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. When we met him in February 2006, he made available for us the raw material of the material recorded by him in Srebrenica and Bratunac area on the 13 and 14 July 1995. And he made available this material to us and we, in his presence, we copied this material using our equipment, the material was copied by our video assistant, and Mr. Petrovic confirmed the authenticity of the copied material.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And in what format was the -- we'll refer to it as the original raw material that he handed to you for you to copy.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was -- it was 8-millimetres tape.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And when you copied it, into what format did you copy that 8-millimetre video?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We did it in the same format and we made a copy also on DVD. As a spare copy on the hard drive of the -- of the video recorder.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And do you recall the name of the video assistant who accompanied you and assisted you in this process?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, of course I remember his name, his name is Zoran Lesic.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: The Trial Chamber's already heard a little bit about Mr. Lesic and we'll hear more about his involvement in putting together this road book and some of the other features which Your Honours will see before too long.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, when you reviewed this so-called raw footage that Mr. Petrovic gave to you in February of 2006, was it complete and unaltered, or could you tell whether there had been portions that had been altered in some fashion?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: According to Mr. Petrovic, he handed over to us at that time the entire material he recorded in -- in Srebrenica and Bratunac area, but this material was somehow redacted. It's mean that this material has some blank spaces, recorded overs spaces, and is visible that few footages were also played but with edited material of Mr. Petrovic in Belgrade in July 1995, not at this material.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And during this interview with Mr. Petrovic, how did he account for these portions that, as you said, had some blank spaces or there were portions that had been recorded over by Mr. Petrovic? What explanation did he have, if any, for that?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. He explained this -- this redacted portion that he -- he justified it by his unexperienced working as a cameraman. He said that the tape was used several time. He doesn't know, in fact, you know, how it happened that this portion had been redacted or recorded over.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And now as an investigator with a fair amount of experience and certainly with the experience that you've gained as being a key investigator in the Srebrenica investigation, did you believe Mr. Petrovic when he told you this? Did you find his explanation credible? And if so, why did you, and if not, why did you not?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's really very hard to believe it, and personally I have a lot of objection to his explanation why this material was redacted or recorded over, because as we know, that the portion which was redacted, there are a lot of incriminated material, you know, just showing the dead bodies, showing the prisoners. And in fact, we are in possession only of very few footages of this -- this material, this sensitive material, and this is visible for me that they should be more such material on this raw material, but unfortunately it's redacted or recorded over, but I -- I think that during my testimony I will try, Your Honour, to explain you in which place the material was redacted and how many seconds are missing.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And again, let's talk a little bit about as an investigator on this case, can you tell the Trial Chamber how it was that you came to believe that there was material which Mr. Petrovic had shot, and to use your term, incriminating material that Mr. Petrovic had shot but which was missing from this so-called raw material that he gave to you? Can you just provide a little bit more detail about the sources of your belief that he was not telling you the truth when he explained that he simply accidentally recorded over certain portions?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are in possession also of the edited material of so-called Petrovic video, we are calling this Petrovic video, this Petrovic material. The material was broadcasted in the Serbian TV, television on -- I believe on 17 July already in 1995, and this material contains also this let's say very sensitive footages showing us bodies in Kravica warehouse and showing us the prisoners in white house in Potocari. We are in possession of this broadcasted material, redacted material, and what we did, we compared in edited material which was broadcasted from Serbian TV and we compared this material with the raw material handed over to us by Mr. Petrovic, Pirocanac.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And did you have this material which showed in incriminating footage before you interviewed Mr. Petrovic in February of 2006?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. We -- OTP received this material first time it was -- I believe it was March 2002 from Mr. Ljubisa Borovcanin during his interview conducted by OTP. Mr. Borovcanin handed over the VHS tape with this broadcasted material to the OTP.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And you've referred to this material as being broadcast. Can you tell the Trial Chamber what outlet broadcast that material and exactly where, if you know, and when, if you know.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: If we -- if we look at the material on the right corner, top corner of the footage we see the sign of the station who broadcasted this material. This is Studio B from Belgrade, situated in Belgrade. We know that this material was broadcasted shortly after Mr. Petrovic returned to Belgrade in July 1995. As far as I remember, it was 17 July 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And can you share with the Trial Chamber how it is that you recall that it was broadcast be on the 17th of July.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I believe it also we were -- I don't remember exactly, but I think we were also informed by -- by we got this information from Mr. Borovcanin as well as Mr. Petrovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And we'll talk about this in a little more detail when we get to this portion of the road book. So as you said, we'll refer to the so-called raw video given to you by Mr. Petrovic as the Petrovic video, and we'll refer to the full video or fuller video that incorporates or contains the unredacted incriminating portions as the Studio B version since it was broadcast by Studio B. So we'll really be talking about Petrovic video and Studio B version of the Petrovic video. Did the OTP obtain other versions or copies of this Petrovic video from any other sources during the course of its investigation?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we did. The first time we obtained a copy of -- of the Petrovic video, Petrovic -- in fact, later on we compared with the raw material handed over to us by Mr. Petrovic. The first copy we received from -- from BBC, and this material didn't contain the footages from edited version Studio B. This is one copy of this raw material, let's say raw material Mr. Petrovic. Another one we received from Ministry of Defence of Bosnia-Herzegovina. We did receive this material in 2007 on our request. It was this also -- this is another copy of the raw material of Mr. Petrovic. Doesn't contain the -- the sensitive material like the prisoners and bodies in Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And do you recall in which year you obtained the copy of this video from the BBC?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think we got this copy in 2002. If I remember correctly, but I think it was April 2002.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And I think you've suggested this in your prior answer, but have -- have you or one of your colleagues actually sat down and compared the BBC version and the BiH Ministry of Defence version against the raw Petrovic video or the Studio B version?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It was one of my colleague who compared this -- this versions, and of course me as well, but in little bit later stage.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And just to make it perfectly clear, are the BBC versions -- the BBC and BiH MOD versions identical to each other?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, the BBC [realtime transcript read in error "B/C/S"] version and BiH MOD version plus the raw material of Mr. Petrovic are identical.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So the redacted version, as you put it, given to you by Mr. Petrovic is the same thing that BBC and then BiH MOD gave you; is that fair to say?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: We see on transcript at line 6 of page 11, B/C/S instead of BBC.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. That should have been BBC.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, do you recall whether the BBC version, although it was identical to the other two versions that you just mentioned, had any features to it which helped you in the process of putting together the road book and the transcripts, for example?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is video material and also audio is recorded on this material, and it's a very useful one. It's good quality material.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, this copy that you requested from the Ministry of Defence of Bosnia and Herzegovina, can you tell the Trial Chamber a little bit about the circumstances which led up to your request, what was going on in the investigation that prompted you to make this request to the MOD?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: In 2006 in October our team from -- OTP team went to Banja Luka to look at the archive of MOD in Banja Luka, and they had access to this archive, and during this visit, they copied several material, several documents, a lot of documents, and then the team returned to The Hague. The material was put in the system. Everybody has access to the system -- to this material, and I found -- we found in this -- this material scanned the MOD archive one document where is video material raw material Petrovic is mention this document. This document was prepared by Milovan Milutinovic. It was the head of the press centre of the Main Staff of Republika Srpska Army, and there is the information about -- about the raw material of Petrovic video, material -- material recorded in Srebrenica and Bratunac area in July 1995 during the operation in Srebrenica in July 1995, and when I received the copy or the scanned version of this document, I immediately requested Ministry of Defence of Bosnia-Herzegovina for original documents and also for the tape which, according to this document, this scanned document, should be in their hands. And as far as I remember in the following year in January we received the original documents, I mean, Mr. Milovan Milutinovic document, plus receipts of -- of -- of this -- this raw material and tape itself.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Well, let's look at a couple of documents, sir. The first is 65 ter 2179, please. Okay. We see the English version on the left, and it's headed "Centre for Information and Propaganda Activities of the VRS Main Staff." The date is 22 June, 1996. The subject is "Report on Television Footage from Srebrenica," and it's addressed to the VRS Main Staff Security Body, and it's signed Chief Colonel Milovan Milutinovic. Can you tell us what this document is, sir.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. This is document I mentioned just awhile ago. This is information of Colonel Milovan Milutinovic to information directed to the security body of the Main Staff of VRS that raw material of the Pirocanac or Petrovic video exists and is in the possession of Vesna Hadzivukovic, and this person is willing to -- to hand over this material to VRS, and this material contains footages from operation in Srebrenica from July 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Mr. President, the Prosecution would tender 65 ter 2179.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit P1337, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: May we have 65 ter 2180, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Can you tell us what this document is, sir.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is receipt for temporarily seized objects. This receipt is signed by Vesna Hadzivukovic who handed over the video-tape to naval captain Ljubisa Beara, or Colonel Ljubisa Beara, who was head of the security of the Main Staff of the Republika Srpska. And this document and the documents we seen previously, I seen first scanned version of these two documents and later on I requested for originals and requested for the tape mentioned here in this -- this receipt. And I received these three objects.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Sorry for interrupting you. I have heard you saying naval captain Ljubisa Beara or Colonel Ljubisa Beara. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. Naval captain, this is the rank he used in navy, but colonel, this is respective ranking name in the land forces.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: I mentioned that, because that part was missing in the record.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And we can see that the date on this document is two days after the prior document, that is, this document is dated the 24th of June, 1996. Now, sir, based on your work as an investigator on the Srebrenica case, have you seen other documents bearing the signature of Colonel Beara?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I've seen quite many documents signed by Colonel Beara.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And -- and just based on your experience having reviewed, if you can just give us some just ballpark estimate of how many thousands of documents you've -- you've reviewed in the course of your investigation?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: On daily basis I working with the documents from VRS, and thousands.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Based on your review of these thousands of documents and seeing, as you describe, many documents with Mr. Beara's signature, can you tell the Trial Chamber just based on your familiarity with his signature and that of others, does this appear to be the signature that you have come to identify as Colonel Beara's?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The signature here in these documents appear to me that this is signature of Colonel Beara, and I have no doubts that this is Colonel Beara's signature.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Mr. President, the Prosecution would tender 2180.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: It will it be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit P1338, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's get started with the book. I note, as the Presiding Judge has, that the cover bears the title of the prior case. Unfortunately, if we were to monkey around with this at all and try to even change the cover, the whole thing has to get re-ERN'd and a new document has to be produced, so we figured it'd probably save a little bit of trees and time and just use exactly what we used in the last trial. So it does bear the prior case name and number on it. Sir, please give the Trial Chamber just a brief overview of how you set this book up. What is the basic approach?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. May I ask for the hard copy of this notebook?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: With the assistance of the Court usher, it should be handed over.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: As I said -- may I? As I said, in February 2006 we interview Mr. Petrovic, Pirocanac. He made available for us the -- his raw material. We made a copy of this material, and together with video assistant Zoran Lesic who did it personally because he's expert of this field. And when we return to The Hague, we just -- I play personally these -- these raw materials -- the copy of these raw materials several times and I asked Zoran Petrovic to pause -- to pause this material in particular places and copy the still images from -- from this material to the hard drive, and I also ask him to print out the still images from the material. We did it for our further action. It's mean that we got the copy of the raw material, the printed version of the stills from this -- from this material, and we went together on mission to Bosnia-Herzegovina, to the area where the material was recorded, which means to Potocari, Srebrenica, Zeleni Jadar, the road leading from Bratunac towards Konjevic Polje, Sandici, Kravica, all this area. Having these stills from the raw material of Mr. Petrovic, a hard copy of the stills, and having also the copy of the video -- video recorded by Mr. Petrovic, we drove the same way which was driven by Mr. Pirocanac together with Mr. Borovcanin, and using the features of -- of the terrain and -- we located all the places which were recorded by Mr. Petrovic, Pirocanac, and when we already located these places we took our own pictures of these places. Also, we recorded GPS readings of these places, and then when we did it, we returned to The Hague, and we unloaded all the pictures we took on this mission. I think this mission occurred in May 2006. We unloaded all these pictures to the computer of visual unit, and then we started to create -- I started to create this -- this book with the technical help of Mr. Zoran Lesic, our video assistant. And as you see, this is -- I divided this book for five chapters. The five chapters contains information and pictures from the Petrovic video, and the pictures taken by me and Mr. Lesic on the mission in 2006 in Bosnia-Herzegovina.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Let me stop you right there if I could.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Before you put your next question, may I ask a simple thing. At the beginning of this lengthy answer you said -- you referred to an interview in February 2006 with Mr. Petrovic, Pirocanac. Earlier this morning you said Mr. Zoran Petrovic also known as Pirocanac. Can you tell us how do you know that this is the same person?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This person used these two names in fact, and he confirm that he using these two names, and most of the people know him as Pirocanac -- Pirocanac, and during the interview in 2006, he confirmed that he's using also nickname of Pirocanac.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Pirocanac is his nickname and he used it in his profession as journalist --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: -- is that correct.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Let's go back to this mission in 2006 just for a couple moments. Prior to that mission, can you give the Trial Chamber an idea of how many times you'd already been to the areas recorded in the Petrovic video Srebrenica, Potocari, Kravica, Sandici, Lolici, Pervani, and Zeleni Jadar?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Prior to this 2006 mission I was -- I'd been in this area many times. It difficult for me to count how many times I was there. I'm very familiar with this area.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: You mentioned that you brought a GPS to assist you in this project. How many GPS devices did you in fact bring, sir?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We used in fact to avoid any errors or mistakes we took with us two GPS devices with us. We compare each GPS readings on each devices when we -- I recorded personally the readings from these devices.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And can you tell it us a little bit about some of the specialised equipment that Mr. Lesic used on this mission?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. He used his own photo equipment. He had also the video player with him, which -- on which we could play the copy of the raw material of Mr. Petrovic, and he -- he had also the various lenses of -- of this -- this photo camera. And I had also my own photo camera.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And did he also photograph some of these locations with what's referred to as a fish-eye lens?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, he did, and later on I will show Your Honour the presentation which we prepared using -- using the material recorded by -- also by Mr. Lesic, or photos used -- made by Mr. Lesic and by me.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Before I interrupted you, you were about to tell the Trial Chamber about the five chapters of the book. Can you -- can you tell us what those chapters are?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. As I said, I divided this book for five chapters, but at the beginning of the book I have three maps of Bosnia-Herzegovina, as you see, and also aerial image of -- of -- of Bosnia-Herzegovina depicting the area where the Petrovic material was recorded. And I divided this material for five chapters, the first chapter is in fact related to Potocari, to the Petrovic material recorded at Potocari, and our photos also recorded at Potocari, or made in Potocari; and the second chapter is related to the road, Sandici -- Kravica-Sandici-Lolici-Pervani; the third chapter is about Srebrenica itself; and fourth chapter is in Zeleni Jadar; and the fifth one is -- I call it mosque Azemina. This is the mosque located at the exit of Srebrenica when we are driving from Srebrenica towards Bratunac. And the first two chapters, Potocari and the road Sandici-Pervani-Lolici was created base off the recordings of Mr. Pirocanac, recording from the 13 July 1995. The third chapter Srebrenica-Zeleni Jadar and a mosque Azemina is related to the recordings from the 14 July 1995. And as I said, at the beginning of each chapter I attached the map with the help of one person from our GIC unit, and on the map I marked the position with the yellow dots, I marked the position of -- of -- of spotted location recorded by Mr. Pirocanac and later on spotted by me. I plotted this location on this map.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, you've referred to maps a couple of times it. Let's just open the book itself to pages 2 and 3. And again, this is P1251. I think pages 2 and 3 are fairly self-explanatory. And if we turn the page to pages 4 and 5. Can you tell us just a little bit about what you have here depicted on -- on the map -- on these two maps.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. On the page 4 we have general map of the area where the material was recorded, and in the boxes, in the four boxes in this -- this map we marked exactly the area where the material -- that Petrovic recorded his material. We see these and from the top we see the Kravica -- Kravica area. We see in the -- going to down we see Potocari, we see Srebrenica and Zeleni Jadar area. On the right side we have more or less the same, but this is aerial image of the same area. I mean, I am referring to the page 5 of this map.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So page 5 is an actual photograph of that same area as the map depicted on the prior page, page 4; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, you refer to another unit here at the Tribunal, and I'm not sure if the transcript caught the acronym you used. Could you repeat what that unit was that helped you with this making these maps?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is GIC, geographic information data unit, but I think it's rather too big word, unit, only one person works for this -- for this project. Let's say you're -- dealing with the maps.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And in the course of putting these maps together with this person from the geographic information unit, did you make use of your GPS readings, and, if so, can you tell the Trial Chamber how that played into creating these maps and the presentation that we'll be seeing.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. I said I -- when we spotted the location we recorded also the GPS readings from this location, and when I returned to The Hague, with the help of this person from geographic information unit, I plotted these -- these GPS readings on the maps prepared also by the person from this unit.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: So is it fair to say that using the GPS data that you obtained, this person with the geographic information unit obtained imagery and helped you plot the exact locations based on information that she had available to her to precisely locate these locations?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, just to jump ahead a little bit, when we get to the interactive CD that allows the operator to open up various links, can you tells us how, for example, this map on page 5 will work in that presentation?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: When we come to this presentation I will show you that we can use the links, you know, also clicking in particular portion of the maps, we can use the links getting us to the particular location like Kravica, like Sandici, like Potocari, or like Srebrenica. Not Srebrenica because, in fact, the presentation is related only to Potocari and -- and the road Kravica-Sandici-Lolici-Pervani.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go move to the first chapter which begins on page 6, and what we're going to do for a little while is Ms. Stewart will play the Petrovic video in Sanction and stop it from time to time so we can examine the hard copy of the road book in conjunction with what she is playing on the video. So if we look here on the first chapter -- if we look at page 7, we have another map, and there are a series of yellow dots and numbers next to them. Can you tell the Trial Chamber what those dots represent and how you were able to place those dots in those particular locations on this map?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: These maps, this is also created -- not created but -- I received this map from GIC unit, and this map depicts the detail map of Potocari area. These yellow dots, as I said, they are GPS -- GPS readings recorded by me and by Zoran Lesic on the -- of the spotted location during our mission, and -- and we plotted these location on this map, and these map -- these dots -- these yellow dots on the numbers, they reflecting the pictures or the stills, the still frames, recorded or just copied from the Petrovic video and our pictures taken during our mission in -- in May 2006. In the following page, if I can explain. In the follow page, in each chapter is followed by the page with the stills frames from Petrovic video on the left side of the book, and the following page, following, we have our picture depicting the same area, explaining us the location of this area right now. Maybe not right now because it was done in 2006, but how the area looks in 2006.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So just so the record is clear, the -- pardon me. The image on page 8 is a video still from the Petrovic video, and the image on page 9 is a photo that you and Mr. Lesic took on your mission in 2006. Is that how basically it's going to work in this book?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. On the left page of this book we have the image from -- from Petrovic video. On the right side we have our photos.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And if we look at the lower left-hand corner of page 8, we see a little yellow dot which says "Position on map 1." Can you tell us what that refers to?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This -- this yellow dot here in -- with mark as number 1, this -- this is exactly the location spotted by us and recorded by Mr. Petrovic in 1995, and this location is marked -- is plotted on the map on the previous page, on the page 7 from this book.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Using GPS readings, of course, we had in our possession.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer, to have the record clear, it says the position on map, and this is the position 1 and not map 1 as it is recorded on line 10, page 22. Because it's the map number 4. If you look at line 10 of the current page.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Oh, I see. I'm a little slow. I see, Your Honour. Yes. The --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: It is map 4, position 1.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Yes, that's right, Mr. President. I read that a little too fast, I think, so it looks like it's map 1. You're absolutely right. It's map 4, position 1, page 7. Now -- and we can see on this map 4 on page 7 that these locations are on this road that runs north-south, and we will see other maps and images depicting this road to give you a better idea, Your Honours, of some of these precise locations.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, just looking at one other item of information on page 8. In the lower left-hand corner of the video still, we see a series of numbers, and it's basically 37:13. What does that depict?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the counter we used during the recording of the raw material from Mr. Petrovic. Is exactly the same recording counter we used during the copy of the material which was given to us by Mr. Petrovic. And this refers, in fact, to 37 seconds and 13 frame of -- of -- of this recording.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So that last -- the last group of numbers is going to refer to the actual number of the frame and not some component of time like a tenth of a second or anything like that. Is that what you're telling us?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, it's correct. It's correct and -- yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And if we look at page 9, at the photograph that you took, we see in the middle of the image the letter A with an arrow pointing down. Can you explain to us what that depicts?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. On the page 8, as you see I marked this photograph on the page 8. The still frame from Petrovic video as the frame A, and I spotted this location while he'd been in Potocari, and I marked this location as location A on the map and on the picture from the page 9. This is the same -- the same building.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And while we're here, can you tell the Trial Chamber what this building was in July of 1995 and what it was used as or for?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This -- this building was used by the Dutch UNPROFOR. It was the main Dutch UNPROFOR base in Potocari, but in each page I also mentioned the location of the frame and of the picture taken by us, and you see here on the page 8, on the bottom of page 8 and also on the bottom of page 9, location Potocari, Dutch UNPROFOR base.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I marked also on this still from Petrovic video and our picture direction of Bratunac and Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And we'll -- we'll get to some of the direction issues in a -- in a moment.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Let's run the Petrovic video, and I'll note for the record that this is 65 ter 1413, video number V000-6747. Ms. Stewart, if you'd go ahead and run the video, please. We'll start.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Sorry, I have no -- no broadcast on my screen.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. That's a slight issue. Thank you. And while we're getting Mr. Blaszczyk some video, I just note for the record, and we always have this problem when we run videos in Sanction or, frankly, from just about any programme, there will be a permanent four-second time difference between what is shown on the video counter as Ms. Stewart is playing it and what is shown on the time counter in the road book. So if you were to look at the Petrovic video on the original machine or whatever it was that we used to make this, it's the time that we've recorded in the road book, but when you go ahead and play it, there's a little bit of a delay. So you can basically add four seconds to every counter time that you see on these images, and that's just something we'll -- we'll live with, and Ms. Stewart is aware of that, and --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Have you any idea about the reason?

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Maybe it takes the electricity that long to get to the computer, but I don't know, Mr. President. It's just one of those weird mechanical things that we've encountered forever.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Technical miracles.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Yes. JUDGE FLUEGGE. Thank you. Please, perhaps you can help us with that, Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I will try, Your Honour. But, yes, this is correct. This is just the counter of the exactly I use in this book exactly which we used during the copy of the material from Petrovic. But for some reasons the Zoran Lesic, he tried to explain me why using different player or different machine the time counter is totally different than -- than in our machine. It's related to the frames of -- of -- not to the seconds exactly but to the frames captured by -- by this particular machine.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. You've already told us what is depicted in both the video still we have on the screens in front of us as well as on page 8. Can you -- and I know this is an obvious question, but for the record can you tell us what village or location we're talking about here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are talking about Potocari, and we are in Potocari. It's on the stop frame -- on the frame of this Petrovic video we see the UN Dutch base in Potocari, and also more or less is the same picture I have in my -- my book on the page 8.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And we can see the DutchBat sign on top of that building. I take it when you went on this mission in June 2006, that sign was no longer on -- on the building; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, is correct. The sign is not any -- more long on this building.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And can you tell the Trial Chamber in which direction is the vehicle travelling at this moment.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The vehicle containing Mr. -- with Petrovic and Borovcanin, his driver is driving towards Potocari, towards Srebrenica from Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And just to give us some compass directions, can you orient us in terms of where Bratunac is located in relation to Srebrenica? Is Bratunac north or south of Srebrenica?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Bratunac is in -- north from Srebrenica. It's located few kilometres from Srebrenica, about 15 maybe kilometres from Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And so just to help us out a little bit as we see other footage later on and other documents, if -- if the DutchBat Compound is on your left, that means you're facing south and you're facing Srebrenica; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's correct. It's --

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And if you see a photograph, if you're standing and the DutchBat Compound is on your right and you're looking forward, that means you're facing Bratunac and Srebrenica is behind you; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could you repeat that?

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: If you're standing on the road and the DutchBat Compound is on your right --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: -- that means you're looking north towards Bratunac, and to your back is Srebrenica; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. It's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, we'll get to the white house in more detail in a little while, but while we're on this photograph on page 9, can you just tell it us approximately where the white house is located. We don't see it here, obviously, but can you just give us a sense of where it's located in relation to this photograph?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. I -- if we look at this photograph from page 9, this photo was taken exactly in the front -- from the front of the white house. Behind back of photographer, there is a white house. We call the building this white house.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And in this photograph we see a -- please continue.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And during the presentation it would be very well visible just, you know, where the location is.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And in this photograph we see a small two-door car heading north towards Bratunac. Can you tell us whether or how close that car is to the entrance to the former DutchBat Compound?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's about 15 metres.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I mean 15 metres to the entrance to the DutchBat. You know, just this is smaller road leading us to the entrance of the DutchBat, but at the beginning of this -- this small road there is also at that time it was the check-point of the Dutch. This car is about 10, 15 metres from this check-point, Dutch check-point.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: But the real entrance was a little bit further down.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, let's turn the page in the hard copy to pages 10 and 11, and we'll continue playing the video, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Sir, we have stopped at Sanction time 54:4, and we can see this video still in -- sorry, video still A on page 10. Can you tell us what is recorded here in still A?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: As we see here on this still and on the -- also on the still from my book, this is -- this still depicts the men walking along the road towards Bratunac. The men using the right side of the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And so --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: If we are facing towards Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So they are heading from south to north; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's correct. Yes. They are heading from south to north.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And we see a number of vehicles, mostly trucks here, next to this column of men, and if we look down, we can -- in video still D, we also see a bus with some other trucks. Are all of these vehicles pointing in the same direction?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. All these vehicles are -- are heading -- are pointed to the same direction, direction to Bratunac north -- north.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's continue playing the tape, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. We're at 1:02 in Sanction, and we can see this corresponds with video still B on page 10. I note that you've identified the Feros building in still B, and how are you able to do that, sir?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is very characteristic building. You see the red bricks on this building and the shape of the windows. Is very visible that this is the same building in almost the same shape right now even, and also was in the same shape in 2006.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And if we look in the hard copy at page 11, photograph 2 --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: -- do we see some kind of a sign on top of the building, and, if so, can you read what that stays on top of that building in photograph 2?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is still mark of -- it's local language "Tvornica Feros." I believe this is in English Feros company. This is this Feros building. And behind this building we see a little bit -- we call this blue factory. It's also the blue building behind the Feros building.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. We're going to play a little bit more tape and then talk about a couple other images.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: May I?

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Please.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just to letting you better view of this area. These pictures of -- from the page 2 of this Feros building, and the picture number 2 was taken also from the position of where the white house is located, just in front of the white house, crossing the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. We've stopped at 1:11 of Sanction, and we see a soldier to the left in between two buses, and we saw him gesturing towards that Muslim man who's facing him. Can you -- can you tell us, based on your investigation, interviews of survivors, and other sources, what eventually happened to these men as they were walking along this column of vehicles.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is visible from this video. You can come to the conclusion that this is selection process. You know, the soldiers letting know to the men that they have to walk on the left side of -- of the road, and then during the course of our investigation, we -- we established that this men -- most of the men were kept first at the white house and then transported to Bratunac to Vuk Karadzic school soccer field in Bratunac, and in the following day were transported to Zvornik area.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: If --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Just a moment. Judge Nyambe has a question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you just play back this -- this footage and let the investigator indicate the selection process. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And I would also invite the Trial Chamber to -- it's difficult sometimes, but we have the subtitling at the bottom, and actually if you look what we have right here on the still frame where Ms. Stewart has stopped in Sanction, you can see the statements: "No. You go left here, to the left. Let's go, in a column, one by one, don't get jammed up like that, to the left." And we'll back it up. It's a little hard to see, but you will see an encounter between these two gentlemen, and we'll start maybe 15 seconds before where we are here.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: To have it clear on the record, I would like to know, LJB seems to be -- I don't know. Perhaps the witness can explain LJB, NMG 1, and NMG 2 and ZPP. What does that mean?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: LJB, we recognised the voice of Ljubisa Borovcanin, I believe, and ZPP, this is the voice of Zoran Petrovic, Pirocanac, and -- and NMG 2 and NMG 1, they are the voices of unidentified soldiers of VRS or police officer of VRS.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: I can tell the Court, I don't think there'll be any dispute about this, that NMG is the acronym of "unidentified person" in B/C/S. So if it were in English we would use UM for unidentified male or UF, but we're using the B/C/S abbreviation so it doesn't immediately look familiar to us. And we've restarted at 59.8 in Sanction.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Can we just stop there. I think you could see right there, and we're at 1:06.5, we're a little beyond the portion, but I think we could all see that there were some women that were heading in one direction and all of a sudden you could see the men, some of the men veering towards the left, and if you like, we can back up a few seconds and look at that again.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Go ahead, Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And if you notice, Your Honour, you see on the right side you see -- we see only the men, and a few of the men, they tried to cross the road and to get to the right side of the road if you are heading towards Srebrenica, but the soldiers were standing next to the trucks, they didn't let them pass by.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And we are at 1 minute 11.3 in Sanction, and we've -- we can see this soldier gesturing, waving with his left hand at these men, and again the audio has picked up somebody, we're not sure who it is, saying: "No, you go left, here, to the left. Let's go, in a column one by one, don't get jammed up like that, to the left." And we can just keep playing it here, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And where are we here, Mr. Blaszczyk? We're at 1:23.1 in Sanction, corresponding to video still C on page 10.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, you're right. This -- this footage from the screen correspond to my book on the still I numbered as C. And we see the same road, but we see the women walking on the left side of the road now.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And we can continue playing.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, we've stopped at 1:38.6 in Sanction. This corresponds to still D on page 10 of your book. And this will be my last question for you before the break. The men that we see in -- or the column of men that we see in video still A on this page, where is that column of men located in relation to the image, the video still, in video still D?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This column of men from the -- from the still A are located in exact in opposite side of the road from -- from still D.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: So are they on the other side of that column of trucks and buses?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, you're right. This other side of the column of trucks and buses.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Mr. President, I think we can safely break now, and we'll pick up with this.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: We must have our first break now and resume at 11.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer, the Chamber is considering the possibilities of the best use of court time. Everybody knows that we have seen most of these -- this video already. The Chamber has been in this location during the site visit. You should think about how to use the court time in the best and sufficient way. Perhaps you can shorten some part of showing the video again, especially if we are facing the possibility to see it again with another witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. I'll certainly take that on board.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, sir, if we look at page 11 and your photo 3, and again this is to really focus on why -- why you're here today with this project, can you tell the Trial Chamber how it was that you were able to place video stills A through D on photograph 3 on page 11? What enabled you to make this determination?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: As I said, I know this area very well. I compare the shape of the road, I compare the location of the houses in -- in Potocari, on the buildings in Potocari, and I noticed some details which are still exist in Potocari. At least they were existed up in 2006 when I took these photographs together with Mr. Lesic in Potocari.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And of course, as I said, you know, I played the video several time and I noticed a lot of details which I used, you know, just to locate exact location where the footage was recorded.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's turn the page and we'll look at pages 12 and 13 in the book. And we can dispense playing with the video for this force. We can see on page 12 four still images. Can you tell us where this is located?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This place depicted in these two pages and the page 12 and 13 is located about 50 metres north of the Ekspres bus compound in Potocari, and in fact just next to the -- we call it blue building, in Potocari, and also about 50, 100, less even, metres from white house in Potocari. Direction to Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And we can see on page 13 in this photograph a large hill in the background. Did this aid you at all in making some of these determinations?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. If you look at this hill from my photograph, from the page 13 and the hill in the background of the footage of Petrovic video, we can compare. We can see that this is the same hill. And also if you look at the strip on the right side, on the road, you know, on the right side of -- almost in the middle of this photograph, my photograph, is the same strip is visible on -- on still frame D from page 12.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And when you refer to that strip, you're talking about a strip on the road that we can see basically leads up to that UN APC; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. This is kind of -- it's difficult to say bridge, but below there is a stream.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So there is a stream that runs basically underneath the road where we see that strip. Is that what you're telling us?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And in the course of your investigation, have you heard references from witnesses and -- about -- about such a stream or creek and a bridge in this location?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I did. I did. I heard a story about stream and bodies next to the creek or stream from the Dutch Battalion soldiers, but the bodies were located not exactly in this place but behind -- behind the white house, behind electrical -- behind the blue building and behind the electrical power station.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. The last thing I want to do on this portion is if we look at video still D on page 12, we can see visible here three UN APCs, and we can see the two in the foreground have been tilted towards each other. What can you tell us just briefly about that.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's one of the -- one of the Dutch soldiers, officer described us at this -- at this location. It was set up the check-point containing these three APCs. UN Dutch check-point.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And have you seen aerial imagery which reflects the exact position of these APCs as depicted in video still D on page 12?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I've seen.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And we'll take a look at that a little later, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We're going to fast forward a little bit to 4 minutes, 49, in the original counter, which will be 4:53 in Sanction. Okay. We've stopped at 4:54, and we can see that there's a time and date stamp on the video image here. What can you tell us about what your investigation disclosed about the accuracy of this time and date stamp of Mr. Petrovic's video?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is time and date stamp from the -- originally from the raw material of the Petrovic video, and we established and we are pretty sure that reflects the correct time and the date in the video. We establish on the base of the Petrovic interview and also from the statements from other witnesses.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Although Mr. Petrovic wasn't sure whether -- whether -- whether the -- the date and even time is -- is correct, because he explained that he's not experienced man to operate with this video camera.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And again based on your investigative experience and your experience as a Srebrenica investigator, how credible did you find that statement that he couldn't tell you whether the date and time was really accurate or not?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: In regards to -- it's difficult to say, because, in fact, you know, he really -- he may have a problem to -- to operate the camera, and maybe he didn't pay much attention for the date and time, but -- but -- but I am sure that -- that he knew that this is the correct time and correct -- especially correct date.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And just for the record, we have here reflected in the time code 1500 hours, 26 minutes, and 50 seconds, 13 July 1995, and we'll take a look at some aerial imagery later and see how that matches up in terms of the time depicted on the aerial imagery. Now, looking at this photograph that you've made on page 13, I just want to orient us with identifying a couple of these buildings. There's a building on the left behind the fence. What is that, and was that there in July of 1995?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The first building on the left-hand side from the picture from the page 13, this is new building, relatively new building. I think it was building 2005 or even 2006. In July 1995, the building didn't exist at this place. And behind this building, behind the fence, we see the small building, white building, with -- and next to this building we see the bus. This is the bus compound.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And that's the compound of the Ekspres bus company?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that is correct. This is the compound of the bus Ekspres company.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And that's on the left hand part of the screen. If we look at the right-hand part of the screen just above where we see the word "Srebrenica" near the arrow that's turning to the left, there are a couple of large buildings there. Can you tell the Trial Chamber what those building are.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The first building on the right-hand side from the picture from the page 13, this is Zinc Factory. And the following building, the factory, the big factory, this is an Energoinvest factory in Potocari behind the Zinc factory. On the right side we see the red car, and behind this car this Zinc factory is visible -- partially Zinc factory, and behind this Zinc factory we have Energoinvest factory, I think.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's turn the page and look at the next series of photos and stills. We're on pages 14 and 15 of the road book, and I think we all recall Ms. Gallagher testifying about -- to some degree about this footage where we have the water trailer hooked up to the tractor. We have Mr. Borovcanin arriving, Colonel Kingori, then Major Kingori, also arriving on the scene and pressing Colonel -- Mr. Borovcanin and others about the situation of the men in the white house, which Colonel Kingori described as no good. Now, I think we can dispense with actually playing the video. If we look at page 15 at your photos, can you tell the Trial Chamber, please, how you were able to determine that, for example, in photo 1 that location responds video stills A, C, D, E, and F from the Petrovic video.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: At that time when we made these pictures, the building from the picture 1, visible we call it as a blue factory, had the same shape as it was in July 1995. What is visible, barely visible on the video, Petrovic video, and also on the picture C from the page 14.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now let me just stop you there, Mr. Blaszczyk. You just referred to the blue factory in your testimony, and I know the Trial Chamber was recently in this location, but we've got tonnes of buildings and factories and different names. Is this the blue factory or is this known by another name to you?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, it's my mistake. This was known for us as blue building in Potocari, but when Your Honour had opportunity to -- to be in this area a few weeks ago, this building has different colour now and was rebuilt. The area was quite rebuilt.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And is there in fact another building that you refer to as the blue factory elsewhere in this area?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, you're right. I referred to the blue factory. This is the building from the -- is visible this building on the page, also on the page -- sorry, on the page 15, the picture number 2 on the right-hand side of this picture. Across the road next to the Feros building and across the road from the white house.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, if we look at some of these video stills on page 14, we can see in, for example, in video stills D, E, and F what appear to be some fences with wiring running along their tops. The fence posts are shaped like upside down hockey sticks, I guess. Were you able to relate those at all to what you found in 2006 and did that help you identify this location?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, in 2006 in May when we were there they start to remove this -- these poles, this fence from the area, but it was still visible on the ground next to this blue building, and I depict the fence, the poles are depict on the picture 4 from the page 15. And if we can compare that the shape of this -- these remains are the same as -- as visible on the page 14. I am referring to the picture, to the still frame at E and F. And D.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: May I interrupt you for a moment. You are recorded having said on page 39, lines 20 and 21: "On the page 15 the picture number 2 on the right-hand side of this picture. This should be the blue factory." If you look at picture number 2 on page 15, is it -- are you sure that this building is to be found on the right-hand side of this picture number 2?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. I am referring to the blue factory. We call that building blue factory on the right side of this picture, but we are talking right now about blue building which is located on the left-hand side of this picture, visible a little bit.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Yes. Now I understand. Thank you very much. Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. It's -- I think we all recognise that no matter how many times you've been there, it's difficult to keep these locations straight, and it's -- I think it's safe to say it's really important to, and it can't be repeated enough. And I am trying to move it along but -- as I hope as you can tell, by dispensing with a lot of the video, but this is exactly why Mr. Blaszczyk is here. I get things all confused sometimes when I'm talking to him as well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Just go ahead.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, let's look at photograph 3 on page 15. You've identified this building as the blue building. Can you tell the Trial Chamber when we're looking at this photo where the white house is in relation to the blue building.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The white house -- we are talking about the white house from Potocari is located about 50 -- 50, 100, even less, metres from this -- this is blue building in direction to Bratunac if you look at the picture three, behind -- just behind -- behind this blue building next to the road leading us to Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And again to orient ourselves, is the white house on the same side of the road as this blue building or the other side?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The white house is on the same side as the blue building is.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Let's turn the page and we'll look at pages 16 and 17. The Trial Chamber also saw some of this footage with Ms. Gallagher. Can you tell the Trial Chamber basically what has happened in terms of the filming from the prior location we saw at the blue building that brings us to the four video stills on page 16. Can you tell us where we are here on page 16 and how Mr. Petrovic and Mr. Borovcanin got to the location depicted on page 16.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's visible from the video that Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Petrovic, they walked along the road towards Bratunac, and they walk about 50, 100 metres, and they reached the point where white house is located, and the still frames are captured exactly on this place. On -- on still frame B and D, we see the part of the white house in Potocari and part of the fence and gate of this white house. We see belongings of -- of the Muslim men kept in this white house. And Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Kingori, we see him on the picture -- on the frame still C, A -- and A. We see that they're standing next to the white house, and this little bit junction is described on my next following page, on the page 17, the location of Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Kingori and one Dutch member and also the member of the Special Police force. This location is marked here on this picture 1 from the page 17 and A and C.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And how were you able to make the determination that, for example, Mr. Borovcanin was standing at the location where you've marked in photograph 1 on page 17, so close to the white house? How were you able to make that determination?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The first you have to follow the move of -- the movement of the camera which recorded this -- this footage, and you will see that this is located next to the white house, and in the background you see also the hills. The hills are corresponded to the hills. And of course, they are the same hills right now in the same area. And in fact, this area has not been change at all, you know, even -- even few weeks ago it looks the same.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, what is depicted if photograph 2 on page 17, sir?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: On photograph 2 we see the Feros building. I described this Feros building before the break. It's visible also on the other part of the video. And this building is located exactly across the road from -- from white house and will be very well visible on the presentation we are going to play later on, I believe.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's skip some video and we'll go ahead to 8 minutes, 16 seconds in the original counter and 8 minutes, 20 seconds, in Sanction. Now, at this point in the filming in the vicinity of the white house we saw the camera pan across the road, and again what do we have depicted here at 8 minutes 20 seconds in Sanction?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is Feros building, and behind we see the blue factory.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And again we can match up that sign that says "Feros," and we can just see that on photograph 2, page 17. Is that correct, sir?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. It is the same building.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: In fact, the top of this building.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Let's roll the tape just for a couple of seconds until we see the artillery shell that the Trial Chamber's already heard a little bit about.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. We're at 8:52.6 seconds in Sanction.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: The Trial Chamber heard a little bit about this artillery shell. Did Mr. Petrovic ever tell you anything about this shell?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, he did. I think during the interview. He said that this is the shell from -- recorded over on this tape from his balcony. The tape is -- the shell is -- is located in his balcony, and in fact I seen this shell on his balcony because when Mr. Petrovic came for interview in 2006, he came without raw material for this interview, and we asked him to provide us the -- the raw material of -- recorded by him in July 1995, and because of that, he had not this material with him. I went together with him to his house when he collected this raw material, and I seen also this shell on his balcony, and he pointed it out, in fact, this shell to me.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, briefly what we're going to do is play a very quick split-screen comparison I don't think the Trial Chamber has seen, and this is 65 ter 2182. The Trial Chamber has seen the Studio B version with the missing footage that was recorded over by this footage of the shell, but we're going to see something a little different.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Just to orient ourselves. We're at 12.8 seconds of the split screen.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: First of all, can you tell us what we're looking at?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: As we see here, this is the gate or fence -- the gate of the white house in Potocari. On the right side is the screen on the right-hand side -- side we see the footage from raw material from -- Pirocanac, Petrovic raw material. On the left-hand side we see the footage from Studio B broadcast. This is also Mr. Petrovic material but edited material which was broadcasts in July 1995 in Serbian television.
