utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And you've used the term "edited material" a couple of times to describe the Studio B footage. What do you mean by edited?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This means that this material was edited or was put together not in the same order as was recorded. This mean up to the director or what -- up to the person who edited the material who wanted to broadcast this material. They -- they put what was convenient for them, what was think by them that was better to be broadcasted in TV in this order, not necessarily following the order from the raw material.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was cut and not entire material contain -- not this Studio B editing material not containing entire material from raw -- raw tape.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Judge Nyambe has a question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: I think you may have answered my question, but nevertheless let me ask it. Does editing of a video footage include adding or removing material? Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This editing of -- of this footage, rather, includes removing material, because as I said, the Studio B editing material should contain the material what is on the raw tape but not entire material from the raw tape. Is -- is not -- not -- not added any new material for this particular broadcast.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: The Honourable Judge Nyambe anticipated my next question to a large degree, so just to be clear, the Studio B footage as it was broadcast in Serbia, did that play the entire Petrovic video as we've been watching it?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And did it broadcast to the extent it broadcasted portions of the Petrovic video as we've been watching it, did it broadcast it in the order in which we have been watching it and in which it was given to you by Mr. Petrovic and by the BBC and by the BiH MOD?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. This material broadcasted in Studio B doesn't reflect the order from raw material or the material we received from BBC or from MOD. You mean original material except the redacted portion of this material, of course.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And finally when Studio B broadcast this material, did they insert anything that wasn't shot by Mr. Petrovic, Pirocanac during the course of these dates?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, they didn't except -- except if we play this Studio B material we see that on the bottom there are also kind of the lines involving information. Of course, this one is edited, added for -- for this broadcast. Yes, but this is only material from Petrovic video recorded by Petrovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And when you refer to lines of information, what are you talking about?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We should play this Studio B footage, and we see that on the bottom we see the line going on, with information what is going on in Belgrade about what concept, whatever, you know, just not related at all to Srebrenica operation.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: I think sometimes we use the term "crawler" for that kind of running information if you're watching CNN or a station. Is that basically the same thing?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes. I mean this thing.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: But the footages are exclusively from Petrovic video recorded by him in July 1995 in these two particular dates.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Let's continue running the video.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's show that again.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, the Trial Chamber's already heard that the image we have here on the left is from the Studio B version, which was not part of the Petrovic video that you were given, and this is at 21.6. Can you tell us based on the comparison that you made of these two versions how the actual time of the film that is used in each corresponded to each other? How did they match up when you put them next to each other?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: You're referring to time, to time code?

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Not necessary a time code but in terms of -- if you want to answer it that way, sure. Just trying to get at how in terms of the gap that's taken up by the artillery, for example, on the right-hand side fits in with the footage that was retained by the Studio B version and how those matched up.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. When we made this comparison together with -- with video assistant, with Zoran Lesic, and is visible that if when we play the Studio B footage and we play extract from -- from raw material, Petrovic material is the same, except in one point in raw material the recording is stopped, is over-recorded, is recorded over by this shell is visible on the right-hand side of this -- this -- on the screen. And from Studio B footage we see that the recording wasn't stopped. It's mean that going on we see that Petrovic recorded except the gate of the white house. The white house itself is here recorded. Also, the people on the balcony of the white house. This footage was cut off from the raw material or was recorded over on the raw material.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. If there are no additional questions on -- on this split-screen comparison.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: I have only one question. It is your observation that the -- this part of the video with the shell was taped over the original one which we can see on the left-hand side of the screen, over the part of the recording -- the video white house. That means that the part with the shell on the balcony was taken later; is that correct.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. This is my analysis and my opinion.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: The big thing in the middle on the right side of the screen is the shell which you mentioned.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, yes. This is the shell I mentioned previously.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: If we compare these two materials, instead of the shell in the raw material we should see the same still frame what we see in Studio B broadcast.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And when looking, for example, at this footage of the balcony that we see in the Studio B version which Mr. Petrovic told you that he recorded over with that picture of the shell that you saw on his balcony, did you find any evidence that, for example, Studio B somehow took this footage or took some footage of a balcony and itself spliced into the Petrovic video this image of the balcony? Did your investigation disclose that anything like that happened?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. No. It was done -- this is -- this is material from Studio B used only the raw material at that time the entire raw material of Petrovic video, and even Petrovic, during the testimony and during the statement, he admitted that this is footage recorded by him and should be included in this raw material, but for some reason it's redacted from the raw -- raw material.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So again just to be clear, Mr. Petrovic, Pirocanac, admitted to you and acknowledged that he in fact recorded the footage that we see on the left that was broadcast by Studio B?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. If there are no other questions about the split screen comparison, the Prosecution would tender 65 ter 2182.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit P1339, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Additionally, Mr. President, I note that the Studio B version which we're seeing here is again P1250, V000-3826, and has been MFI'd in connection with Mr. Petrovic's 92 bis package. The Prosecution would tender that video as well at this time, just take it off the MFI list.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's switch now from the road book to the interactive CD. And again I note for the record that that is 65 ter 2178. I know it takes a couple moments for you to get set up.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I have problem, if possible, with this laptop.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We have the password. If we could maybe hand that over, or write it down and just hand it to him.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: The court usher will assist.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Okay. It works.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Before we launch into this -- this CD, please give the Trial Chamber an idea of what the idea was behind putting this presentation together. What were you trying to provide?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just making this presentation, I would like to let everybody who were not at this area or they been only once or twice to better oriented in this area. And I think this is very useful material to do it. And creating this presentation, I used the maps which were used for creation of this -- for this road book, and also I used the pictures we used for creation of this road book and the stills from Petrovic material.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay of the let's go ahead and -- and see how it works. Just take us through the -- let's say the first portion of this, which is the Potocari section. And again, there are --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: For a better understanding, the producer of this CD is the witness. You produced this video -- this CD; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, is correct, Your Honour, but of course with technical help of my colleague, video say assistant Zoran Lesic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: So please, sir, just go ahead and take us through the first portion of the presentation. We won't need to hit every link for sure, but just give us an idea of -- of how one can operate this CD and the capabilities it has of basically placing the user at the scene.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And again, Your Honours, you'll have your own version of this to play with when the time comes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: To play this presentation, we use the programme Quicktime Player, and you see on the screen the first page of this presentation, and on the bottom you see the buttons. You can operate these buttons. You see the button on the right-hand side with the question mark over there, if we press this button, you see that the portion of the material is getting blue. It's mean that this portion is letting -- is leading to another picture, map, whatever material. And the button with plus, we can enlarge the video, like enlarge the picture over there on. The other one with minus, we can -- we can minimalise and get to the original size. As I said, helping yourself, you can use this question mark button to get into the presentation. If we press to this blue mark area, we are going to the next page, and we see here a map. This map is also visible on my road book. And again, we see the box marked here on the -- by -- in blue now if I use this question mark button. If we go in, if we press to this part, we are going to another map showing us the area of Bosnia-Herzegovina, and we've mark area of Bratunac, Srebrenica, Kravica, Sandici, all these area. Again, if you would like to -- to go to next page, we can press to the blue field which shall link us to another page, and again we have the map used in our road book, and we have several locations. Then pressing -- if we will -- would like to -- to look at Potocari, at the events we discussed just few minutes ago in Potocari, what happened in Potocari on July 15 and are depicted in my road book, let's go to this. And this portion -- and we see the map is also depicted. In this -- this map is also from the same as we have in our road book. And here we have few points here, few marks. Again, to be sure that we can use this -- they are links to another portion of this presentation, let's mark these signs, and let's go to the first one.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And before you do that, Mr. Blaszczyk, just so we have something on the record, you are pressing that little question mark inside the arrow to basically turn these features blue, and what we're looking at is your map, and instead of the little yellow circles that we had before, we now have arrowheads that you've turned blue by engaging that question mark in the little control panel at the bottom. And in order to go further, you simply do what?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just to press the arrow, wherever you want to go. And right now in the front of the white house. This is the most recent -- the recent -- the picture taken by us in 2006. We can move around.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: So basically by just sweeping with your cursor you can rotate the image; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. You can use this laptop pad or you can use the mouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And again we --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: If we would have a mouse, of course.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And again we see arrowheads floating around on this image of the white house. Can you show us an example of what these arrowhead links do for us.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. If you would like to go in to another link, for example, to the front of the white house, is leading us to the still frame from Petrovic video. And as I said before, we can enlarge this picture using this button. To get to the original size. Okay. Let's go back. Okay. And if you would like to go back to the previous picture, it's necessary only to press again this picture. Going to next link, what is marked here on this picture on -- on the white house balcony, it takes us to the Petrovic Studio B still. Pressing once we enlarge the picture. We are getting better view of the people who are sitting on the balcony of the white house. Pressing one more, we see quite clear picture of the people from the balcony. Pressing once again, we are returning to our, let's say, master picture. And another arrow here getting us to the position where Mr. Borovcanin, Mr. Kingori, and other people are standing in front of the white house. Coming back, we see exact location when this footage was recorded, the still was recorded.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, I -- if you can scroll to the -- okay. I was just going to ask you, I saw the top of that arrow, there's a red and orange coloured arrow that's pointing straight down in the middle of the road here. What is that?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This arrow taking us to the opposite side of the road, opposite side of the white house. And we see what is right now in -- what is located across the road from the white house. We see here Feros building. Behind we see the blue factory. On the left, if we go to the left, we see here the UN DutchBat base, the road leading to Bratunac. If we go to opposite side, we see the road leading to Srebrenica. On the right side is not visible on this picture, but where we see the arrow here there is the location in front of -- of -- of the blue building. I forgot to tell that we can use also the button here to go back if you have -- if anybody has difficulties to find the proper arrow to go back to the previous picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And just for the record, you're referring to the left-most button in that little control panel at the bottom of the image, an arrow facing left.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, is correct. And as we seen before in our road book, we can link to the pictures from Petrovic material. We see the people walking towards Bratunac. This is exactly the location here. Near white house, near the Feros building. If we go to the -- another side of the road, it takes us to the left side of the road, and we see women, children, and elderlies walking on the other side of the road. Okay. And of course we can go back to -- to the view of the white house using this arrow. We see the white house. This is exactly on the opposite side of the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Unless you had any other particular links that you think the Trial Chamber should really see at this point, I think that gives us a pretty good idea of how to operate this presentation. Did you have anything else you wanted to add or explain to the Trial Chamber about this portion, the Potocari portion, of the interactive video?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Generally it works in this way: You can use the arrows here to link us to another part of the place, and we can see the pictures from -- taken by us, by OTP, and -- in 2006, and the stills from Petrovic material, and you can compare the Petrovic material, the stills from the Petrovic material, with the location I spotted on these places.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And if there aren't any questions from the Trial Chamber at this time about the presentation, we'll move on and look at a couple of aerials.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: I think we have received a good manual how to use this CD.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Blaszczyk. I think we can shut that down for now.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: May we have 65 ter 951, please. If we could blow it up just a little bit. I don't know if that's possible. Oh, there we go.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, we have here what's obviously an aerial image dated 13 July 1995 with a number of locations marked, including the white house, the blue factory, the Feros building, the bus compound, the zinc factory, and Energoinvest factory. Based on your experience, sir, are the markings indicating the various structures here accurate?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, they are accurate.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. I don't think we need to spend too much more time. Let me just ask you again about the direction so we can again orient ourselves if we're looking at this later. We see a road, and we can actually see vehicles on this road that runs up and down right in the middle of this image in front of the UN base. Can you tell us which way is north, which way is south, or if you prefer, which way leads to Srebrenica and which way leads to Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. South is at the top, and this is road leading us to Srebrenica, and north is -- is down, at the bottom of this picture, and this road leads us to Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. A little bit of a trick question for you.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: It's an upside down image compared to what we've been seeing, but I thought it would be useful for the Trial Chamber to have this kind of an aerial to see the proximity and other locations. So the Prosecution would tender 65 ter 951.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Before we decide, could you, Mr. Blaszczyk, tell us who made these -- who produced all these indications about the different locations.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: We had received this picture from the US government, and as far as I -- I believe we -- we got it from -- from -- from US.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Is this the original version you received from the US, or who produced, for instance, the inscriptions "white house," electrical station, and so on?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I believe we received this originally from US. When I started to work with OTP, I formed this as part of the collection we received from US government.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Without any -- this version, or was it edited by somebody of the OTP?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: To be honest, Your Honour, I'm not 100 per cent sure, but I seen only this version from US.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Mr. President, I think that's a certain amount of testimony in the record already about who placed these markings in yellow and the arrows, and I'll leave it at that. I mean, I think we already have some testimony to that -- to that extent. It may have -- that testimony may have come in through Mr. Ruez as to who actually placed the -- these yellow markings. The image, obviously, came from the source we all know about.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: But again, sir, based on your being at this location, do you have any of question at all about the accuracy of the indicators here, irrespective of who placed them on the image?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. I am sure this is exactly reflect the situation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Judge Nyambe.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: On line -- on page 56, lines 7 to 8, you are recorded as saying -- Mr. Thayer asked you that: "Based on your experience, are the markings indicating the various structures here accurate?" And you have replied: "Yes." Your conclusion that they're accurate is based on what?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is based on my own assessment of my knowledge of this area.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And I'll note for the record that -- I'm sorry. Sorry, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Based on our recent site visit, are you able to confirm the accuracy of these locations on this aerial picture?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, we can, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: This photograph will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit P1340, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer, are you tendering the CD? We have seen part of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: I can, Mr. President. We have another section to just look at very briefly now that Mr. Blaszczyk has -- has given us an idea how to work it, but the Prosecution will go ahead and may as well tender it now, thank you for the invitation. It's 2178.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: This will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit P1341, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And Ms. Stewart has helpfully tracked down a site for us. Mr. Ruez testified on the 29th of March of this year, at transcript page 914, lines 1 to 4, that he was the person who in fact added these markings to the aerial imagery.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Tolimir.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. President. I take this opportunity to greet everyone present. I wish peace unto this house, and may this trial end in keeping with God's will. The Defence should like to know if this photograph the witness mentioned now was received in the original from the Americans with markings or not. Is it something else? We can't see the difference, and we need to know for purposes of the cross-examination. We'd like to know what the point is here.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Mr. President, I think the record is now pretty clear. Mr. Blaszczyk testified that his recollection is that this document came this way from the United States government with all the yellow markings. Mr. Ruez testified at the site that I provided for the Trial Chamber that he received this image from the Rule 70 provider but added himself the notations that we see in yellow. I think we can comfortably leave it there.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Tolimir, with the assistance of your legal advisor, you will find the relevant part of the evidence of Mr. Ruez, and then you may put questions to that to the witness during your cross-examination. Mr. Tolimir.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I followed carefully, but Mr. Ruez did not consider this picture. He considered another picture related to the stadium, and he said he made markings there, not here, whereas the witness said he received this photograph together with markings from the Americans. That's why I'm nonplussed a bit. Mr. Ruez spoke about another photograph, not this one, and the witness is saying he received this aerial photograph from the Americans with the markings already made. So we don't know what to discuss in our cross-examination.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Tolimir, I understand your position. I would like to ask the witness. You personally didn't produce any markings on this aerial photograph we have on the screen in front of us now; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Is correct, Your Honour, I didn't produce any markings on this photograph. I said I used our set of the photographs we kept in one place as part of the collection of the photographs received from US government.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: When you are saying, "We received this photograph from the US government," can I take it that you personally received it from the government or the OTP. Are you referring to the OTP or to a specific employee of the OTP.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Your Honour, it was -- I'm referring to the OTP, and when we received this material I was not here at the Tribunal. It was much earlier before I arrived to the Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you. I hope that helps everybody. Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And again, Mr. President, I just would refer the accused to the citation that we gave. It's clear that Mr. Ruez was talking about an image that is at page 10 of his own book of photographs that the Trial Chamber may recall. Mr. Ruez has a book about two inches thick, and it's P00094, admitted in through his testimony, and it's at page 10 of that document. You can just go to it any time on e-court, page 10. You'll see it right there. He spoke about it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much, and please carry on.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: May we have 65 ter 957, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Pardon me. As you can see, we have another aerial image, again dated 13 July 1995, at approximately 1400 hours. We can see that it has many of the same markings as the previous image, but there are some additional ones, and we can also see that this image is of a more focused area than the image we just saw, a little bit further to the south, in the direction of Srebrenica. My first question for you, sir, is again based on your familiarity with this area, the location, the features, can you tell the Trial Chamber whether the notations on this image are accurate?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I am sure that the notation of this image are accurate. Is -- yes, is as you said, you know, is marked more places than before, on the picture we seen before, but we see also the Feros building but is not marked here but is visible on this picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Well, while we have it up, maybe you can take the pen and mark this exhibit and show us where the Feros building is.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I cannot mark it on the screen for some reason.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We may need to disconnect the computer.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: The technician will assist us in a few minutes. I think you should carry on your examination, and then we come back to that later on.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. I do have a couple more questions on this image, so -- so I'll do that, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: One of the structures depicted in this image that wasn't on the prior one is the blue building. Do you see that here where it's marked?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I did see.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And again is that the blue building that you testified about in your earlier testimony with regard to the road book?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. This is the same building we see in the picture of this building in my road book.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And right across, a little bit diagonally across that road we see the blue factory. Now, if we can go down -- I'm sorry, if we can go up a little bit on the image to where we see "UN APC" marked. If we could blow that portion up just a little bit, see if we can retain the resolution. Just basically where the point of that arrow is, where it says "UN APC." Okay. We have here a zoomed-in view of an APC, and you can see that it's -- you can see how it's positioned. Can you tell the Trial Chamber how that corresponds to the video footage that you've seen from that day and the other investigation you've conducted about the events of that day?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Maybe it's not visible very clear here, but the position of this APC corresponds exactly to the pictures we have from the -- from the ground, recorded by Mr. Petrovic, and also the information we have from various witnesses but that position of this APC is exactly the places which were -- in the place where -- which was described by me during the commenting this road book.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And when you say it corresponds, in what way does it correspond? How is it positioned?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: That this is located on the road leading us to Srebrenica, and we see at least one APC here just directed -- it's actually blocking a little -- a little bit in the blocking position on the road, on the main road, and this -- this location is not far from the blue building. It's not visible on this blow-up of this picture, but the blue building is located about 50, 60 metres from this position.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And lastly, we see this circle with "People" written next to it. Can you tell the Trial Chamber how that corresponds to the events of the afternoon of 13 July and to what we were seeing in the video in Potocari that afternoon.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We know from the various statements of the people who -- who were at that time on the 13 July 1995 in this area that the crowd of the people was located in this place, and we see also in various video that the crowd of people exactly in this place which is mark here, and we see on the Petrovic video. I think we see it in other videos as well. If we play in this court this trial video they should be visible, the crowd of the people there as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And if we look at the time the picture was taken, it's 1400 hours, but we see that Petrovic recorded -- recorded his material, it was in later stage, about 4.00, afternoon, 3.00 or 4.00 afternoon. It means that the people -- some of the people were moved -- removed already from this location. The crowd is not such visible like in other videos from the 12th.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. The Prosecution would tender 65 ter 957. Oh, before we do that, Mr. President, if we could -- I think we may be able to mark that one item, the Feros building. So if we can zoom back to the original size before we --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Would you like me to mark this building?

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Please. Just mark the Feros building on this aerial, please.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Doesn't work.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Well, maybe you can just describe where it is on the image and we'll just live without marking it. Can you tell us where the Feros building is on this image?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. We see -- we see the blue factory marked here. This is the big building in the left bottom corner, and next to this building we have this little bit grey long building next to the road. This is the Feros building.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Mr. President, the Prosecution would tender now 957.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: I think the witness can try a last time. We'll see if it works. I think it doesn't work. We will receive this aerial image without marking by the witness.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit P1342, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Mr. President, I note that we're approaching the break. It might be a good time so that the technician doesn't have to be on his hands and knees while we're all watching to just take the break now a couple minutes early.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. We will do that. We have our break now and resume five minutes before 1.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Thayer, please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's try it one last time, Mr. Blaszczyk. If you would give it a shot.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Success.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Mr. President, the Prosecution would tender the marked exhibit as well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: And I would like to state for the record we see in red a marking by the witness "Feros" and a "B" indicating Mr. Blaszczyk, is that correct.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It is correct, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: This marked photograph will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit P1343, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. One last aerial. If we could have P1279, please. This has been MFI'd in connection with the 92 bis with cross testimony of Dobroslav Stanojevic, Witness number 122. It might take a moment to load up. If we could rotate that, please. Great. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, we have here an aerial image, I believe shot by J. R. Ruez, from a helicopter. Sir, can you recognise what this image depicts -- this photograph, I should say?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This image -- this photograph depicts the area of Potocari. We see here the UN Dutch base, Feros building, blue factory, blue building, zinc factory, bus compound, white house, yes, all the places we described before the break.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And can you give the Trial Chamber an approximate time period or year when this photograph might have been taken.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: But it was 1998 or 1999. I am not exactly sure, but I -- I remember I seen this photograph. It was taken by Jean Rene Ruez.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: What I'd like you to do, please, is just take that pen and mark the following locations because now we're seeing the Potocari area from an angle that we haven't seen before.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: As --

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: But start moving from the left to the right.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: I'll do it this way. Wherever you see the Ekspres bus compound, could you mark that, please.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I will mark this bus compound as number 1. Oops.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We need to zoom back out.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: We zoom out again.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We need to return to the original image before you mark anything, Mr. Blaszczyk, or else we're going to lose it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Please zoom out again. We need the full area photograph.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: And wait a moment so that the court usher can assist you with the marking.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: So please mark the Ekspres bus compound with a 1.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: I don't know what happened. When you touched the screen with the pen --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I promise I didn't touch it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: But we have to test your credibility. Even further now. I don't know what happened.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I have no pen in my hands.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: This is now absolutely trustworthy. I can see it.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. But we've -- thank you.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Would you like me to --

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And -- freeze. Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I touch it. I don't know --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: I knew it.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. There must be something ...

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So we have number 1 marked at what location, sir?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I marked this location with number 1 as the location of -- the position of the bus, Ekspres bus compound, in Potocari, of course.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's say the zinc factory. Can you mark that with a number 2, please.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Number 2, this is the zinc factory.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And let's say the blue building. Can you locate that and write a number 3 next to the blue building?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. The blue building is visible here also.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And how about the Feros building. Can you mark the Feros building with a number 4, please.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Number 4, this is Feros building. And next to him is blue factory.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Can you mark that with a 5, please.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And the white house with a 6.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And white house is here.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And I think we're safely done with this exhibit. If we could quit while we're ahead, and we'll tender the marked aerial, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: This marked aerial photograph will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit 1344, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And, Your Honours, I mentioned at the outset the unmarked version has been MFI'd as 1279, and the Prosecution would go ahead and tender that as well at this time, the unmarked version.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, you told us that Mr. Ruez has taken this aerial photograph; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. I remember that Mr. Ruez took the tour, you know, by helicopter, around this area, and he also made some pictures of this area.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you. This will --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: But I -- sorry, sir.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Go ahead.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: But I not remember now the date, exact date, but it was much before I arrived to the Tribunal. It was 1998 or 1999, but I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you. This photograph will be received. As P1279.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, before we --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: One moment, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you. Please carry on, Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Before we leave this Potocari section of the road book, you testified in the Popovic case - and this is at page 18607, in case anybody wants to go back - you testified that you had been to these areas in Srebrenica, Potocari, Kravica, Zeleni Jadar, about 40 to 50 times, and this was when you testified at the end of 2007. Do you recall that, and was that an accurate estimate back then?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know exactly how many times I was there, but it was around this number, about 40, 50 times. Each time at this period when I joined Tribunal in 2003 up to 2007 or 2006, I've been quite often in this -- this area, Bratunac, Srebrenica area. It's been almost every few months or two months or three months I was this area.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And since your testimony in Popovic in 2007, can you give the Trial Chamber a rough idea of how many times you've been back to these areas, including Potocari?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: After 2007, in fact I was there just a few times more but not -- not many as before.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. More than 10, more than 20? Can you just give us an estimate?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I would say that about ten times more.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, we're going to turn to the second chapter. If we could all turn to pages 20, 21 of the hard copy road book. Again, for the record, that's P1251. We see on page 21 again your positions marked with the yellow circles. Just to move things along a little bit, are -- are those based upon your GPS readings on this mission that you took in 2006 as we saw with the map before the Potocari section, Mr. Blaszczyk?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, you are correct. Dealing with these yellow dots, I -- I just put these yellow dots on exactly the location I spotted during my mission and location where I got also the GPS readings of these particular places.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And this map is a little bit more crowded than the Potocari map. We see, I think, 19 positions marked, and will we see those positions 1 through 19 further identified as we go through this chapter by particular photographs?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, okay. There are so many -- so many dots here because I used more photos from Petrovic video and my -- my own photos. More in this chapter than in previous chapter.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Well, then let's turn the page to pages 22 and 23. Now, we see on page 22 a photograph that you've identified as being taken by yourself in June of 2006, and just to clarify one thing, I think you've mentioned on a couple of occasions today that your recollection was that mission was in May. We have here in the book that it was June. Do you have any recollection of whether it was May or June, just so we have a little bit of clarity.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. I was there in May, end of May, I believe, in this area, but these photos June 2006, this entry refers to -- to the folder we created when I returned from mission. We created on the computer of visual unit, and we -- we used this date in June 2006 that the photos were located in this particular folder which was used later to create this particular book.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And just before we start getting into the guts of these two pages, again if we look at the next page, 23, we see your little yellow dots with the following notations: "Position on map: 4 and 3." Again, just to save some time, do those refer back to the previous page, 21, where you've numbered these 19 locations along this road?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. These -- these yellow dots are referred to -- to the position marked on the map from the page 21.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, the Trial Chamber has already heard testimony from Ms. Gallagher about this destroyed white house opposite the Sandici meadow, again not to be confused with the white house in Potocari, but before we begin -- or before we resume playing a couple of portions of the Petrovic video, can you explain why you thought it was important to include these two pages which don't have any video stills from the Petrovic video in them?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Especially for the persons who have never been in this area or been there only once or twice, it's rather quite difficult to -- to be orientated in this -- this area, and my reason, my -- my idea was to -- to make it as best as possible the general view of the area and the location of the particular houses or features in this area. This is why I put -- I just dedicated these two pages to my notebook, not like the previous chapter, to showing Your Honour and to everybody who is looking on this notebook, to showing them the best idea how the area looks or looked in 2006, and later on we can compare this area with Petrovic footage. It would be easier, much easier, having these entire pictures, all the pictures here in these two pages.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And just to orient ourselves a little bit, if we look at your photograph on page 22, we see you've provided the directions Konjevic Polje to the right of the photograph and Kravica-Bratunac to the left. Can you tell us which direction Konjevic Polje is from this location?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is direction to the west, this is Konjevic Polje. And to Kravica and Bratunac, this is east direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And do you hit Bratunac -- I mean -- I beg your pardon. Do you hit Kravica before you hit Bratunac if you're travelling from this location?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, first the Kravica is located about 1 kilometre from Sandici meadow in the direction to Kravica to the east.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Tell us a little bit about what page 23 is designed to show us. Help us out with some of these photographs that you've included here. Just explain in -- as best you can.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: On 20 -- on the page 23 I -- I -- we put the pictures of the -- the more detailed pictures of the area of Sandici meadow, including the destroyed white house located just across the meadow, and another picture, picture 2, showing us the meadow, and also destroyed house which is located on Sandici meadow. We can't see this house later on in -- in Petrovic video. And on the page 3, we see panorama picture. This picture was taken from the Sandici meadow and showing us the location which is located across the road from Sandici meadow. We see the destroyed white house and the road leading us to Konjevic Polje and Kravica Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And just to clarify one thing. You said page 3. I presume you meant photo 3 on page 23, Mr. Blaszczyk?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I meant photo 3 from page 23.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And just to make clear one thing. If we look at photograph 2 on page 23 --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Another error occurred, line 2, page 74, the witness said: "I meant photo 3 from --" Now it's corrected. We can carry on.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: If you look at photo 2 on page 23, there is a reference or you've pointed out what you refer to as a destroyed house which is on the same side of the road as the Sandici meadow, and I take it that if we look at the prior page, page 22, you've got an arrow pointing down with that same photograph to a destroyed house that's sitting along the road there on the same side of the road as the Sandici meadow. Is that what you've done here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. You are correct. And on the page 22, I have the general view of the Sandici area, and I use the same photograph. From the right top corner on the page 23 showing us the same destroyed house on Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And we see the location of this house if we look at the general view of the Sandici area.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And we'll be very careful to distinguish when we're talking about this larger destroyed white house as opposed to this smaller destroyed house that we see here. Let's just go to pages 24 and 25. We don't need to play the video. The Trial Chamber heard the testimony from Ms. Gallagher identifying the individual on page 24 as Milenko Trifunovic, also known as Cop, a member of the Special Police Brigade Sekovici. You've -- well, if we look at the next page, page 25, can you tell us who that well-built man in the blue jeans is in photograph A?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's me.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, you've identified the structure that you are facing as the destroyed house, and you've linked that to the video still on the prior page in the upper right corner of that video still A. Just to be clear, if you had wanted to completely replicate the position of Mr. Trifunovic, you should have turned around and faced the camera; is that correct? Would we then be looking at -- at an exact image?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, you're right. I could be mistaken by 1 metre, maybe half a metre, but, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: But when you're looking at the white house here --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: You mean --

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: -- you're not facing the same direction as Mr. Trifunovic. I just want to make that clear for the report. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct, but I'm not looking at the white house, destroyed white house, but I'm looking at destroyed house. We have to distinguish this.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: I violated my -- thank you, Mr. Blaszczyk. You're absolutely right. You -- in the video still, Mr. Trifunovic has his back to the destroyed house. In your photograph you are facing the destroyed house; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. I am facing to this destroyed house, and Mr. Trifunovic is -- is in back side from this house.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, if we look at photograph 2 on page 25, we can see that the road bends in a couple of places. Can you tell the Trial Chamber a little bit about the topography in this area of the road and how, if at all, that assisted you in determining the locations of these various features and buildings and people during the course of this project.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: As you see on this photograph number 2 from page 25, the road is bending, and here is helping us a lot to -- to assist to locate the particular places. If we play the video, we can locate the particular places following the movement of the camera and following also the shape of the road and the surrounding hills and surrounding houses. And this is the picture number 2. This is the general view of Sandici meadow but from the west direction, from the hill located on the west from Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And if we stay with this photograph 2 on page 25, you've also identified the destroyed white house and the Kravica warehouse as being visible. How were you able to do that?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Maybe it's not visible very well on this particular photo in this road book, but if you place this -- these photos or original photo on the computer and you zoom in the picture, the Kravica warehouse is visible. As I said, the Kravica is located from this destroyed white house less than 1 kilometre. And destroyed white house is located on little bit hill. I don't know, Your Honour, if you noticed when you were there that the warehouse is located from this location.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Let's turn the page and we'll look at pages 26 and 27. The Trial Chamber's no doubt familiar with this footage of Mr. Ramo Osmanovic's calling out to his son, Nermin, from seeing it with Ms. Gallagher not too long ago. Can you tell the Trial Chamber how you were able to determine the locations in the two photographs on page 27 of the video stills on page 26.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: As I said, I followed the movement of the camera, and in these pictures, in my pictures I choose the most significant things that -- showing us that this is the same location. This is the small house depicted on the picture -- on the still B from the page 26. We see the same small house on my picture from the page 27 as the picture number marked here as picture number 1.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And if we look at video still B on page 26, we can see that directly above the head of Mr. Osmanovic, as it were, there appears to be a rise, a horizontal rise or ridge extending from left to right. Were you able to use that or did that help you at all in locating this position?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it -- it helped me very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And where can we see that in photo 1 or 2 on page 27?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. If you look -- if you look at the photos number 1, you see. You see exactly the same shape of the hill here, but the picture number 2 from the page 27, this is the picture taken from the position when the man is depicted from the previous page, page 26.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So that ridge is not visible in photo 2 because it's -- the photo is being taken from the perspective of the men in photo, say, C, for example, or B, looking towards the destroyed white house; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is correct. This is totally different direction. We are back to this hill, you know, depicted on the -- on the page 20 -- 26.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. We can move along a little bit and then dispense with playing some of the video. If we go to the next page, page 28, and then page 29. The --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Judge Mindua has a question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. I have a question to put to the Prosecutor. Mr. Thayer, will we be hearing a witness had will come to talk to us again about Mr. Ramo Osmanovic's fate who was calling out to his son Nermin? Will somebody come to talk to us about these two men?

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Your Honour, off the top of my head, I can't recall whether we have a Bosnian Muslim witness who is still a viva voce, 92 ter, or 92 bis with cross witness who talks specifically about Mr. Osmanovic or his son. I can tell you that we have two witnesses who are 92 bis with cross witnesses who were among this group that we see here of Muslim men sitting on the meadow who will talk about the events that took place on the meadow, and we will have testimony from Ms. Gallagher as early as perhaps tomorrow about the fate of Mr. Osmanovic in connection with the DNA identifications, the men who still remain on the missing list reports from family members, for example, that they are still missing. So you will hear some testimony concerning Mr. Osmanovic, but I can't tell you whether we have any witnesses who are available to come tell you specifically about him based on their observation of him at the time, but I will get back to the Trial Chamber on that, certainly.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Fine. Right. You will get back to us on this at a later stage. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And for the record, the two witnesses who will be coming to talk about their experiences at the Sandici meadow are Witnesses 51, who has been assigned the pseudonym PW-14, and Witness 52.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: The last part of the transcript is the answer of Mr. Thayer and not mine.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And I think as I alluded to, of course, part of Ms. Gallagher's testimony about the -- what we refer to as the Muslim ID book will, of course, to some degree rely on the evidence of Mr. Janc concerning the DNA identifications of these men from mass graves. Mr. Janc's report is P00170.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, looking at page 28, we have some stills of various armoured vehicles in A and B, a truck in C, and a tank in D, and you've made some determinations on page 29 in your photograph of where some of these vehicles and the tanks were located. I first note for the record that these images are spread out over several minutes of the Petrovic video, and we don't need to play those again, but if we note photograph A is at 9:28, and photos C and D are at 21:31. Again, sir, how were you able to make the determination with respect to the locations of A and B which you've marked here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: As I said, I carefully analysed the movement of the camera which recorded these -- these events, and also I analysed the features of -- of -- of the hills in the background of -- from the Petrovic video and also when I was on the spot. The shape of the hill.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, for example, we don't see video still D, the tank, marked anywhere on your photograph on page 29. Why not?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This tank is definitely on Sandici meadow, and also the truck on -- from the page 28, still C, but I was not able to -- to spot the exact position of the tank and truck. I know that this is in Sandici meadow. I have my own assumption, but I was not able to determine the proper location of this tank and truck.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's just turn the page and go to pages 30 and 31. I don't think the Trial Chamber has actually heard any identification of the individuals in video still A. I -- I believe that they are included in Ms. Gallagher's ID book that she referred to during her testimony. Mr. Blaszczyk, do you have any idea off the top of your head of the identities of these two individuals in video still A? If you don't, that's fine.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I know that these two men depicted on the picture A are brothers. One of them is the member of the Special Police Brigade. Another one is the member of 1st Company of PJP, but I don't remember their names.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: That's fine. And the Chamber probably remembers that the brother on the right showed Mr. Borovcanin his pistol and said something to the effect of, "Boro, do you want to swap guns?" We don't need to see it again. But how were you able to pinpoint the location of these two men as you have on page 31 showing A and B?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The same, analysing the pictures, the still captured from Petrovic video and looking at my picture from the page 31. On the left-hand side we see the destroyed white house. If you look carefully on the picture B from the page 30, you see part of this house on the left corner, top corner, behind, above the head of Mr. Borovcanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
